assignment: BACSE344 Cloud Infrastructure and Architecture - Digital Assignment 3
task: Question 1(b) - Performance Benchmark (1 Instance vs 3 Instances)
benchmark_tool: ApacheBench (ab) Version 2.3 via official httpd:alpine container

single_instance.command: docker run --rm --network spacesync-network httpd:alpine ab -n 1000 -c 15 http://backend-1:5000/api/resources

three_instances.command: docker run --rm --network spacesync-network httpd:alpine ab -n 1000 -c 15 http://nginx/api/resources

comparison.evaluation: Adding two additional backend instances behind Nginx more than doubled throughput (+107.63% RPS) and reduced mean response latency by more than half (51.84% drop). Under concurrency 15, the single instance pool (DB_POOL_MAX=7) queued concurrent queries, whereas the 3-instance cluster provided 21 aggregate connections, eliminating connection wait queues.
